narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Forty seven gave three, so the answer after dividing is always three.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Try twenty nine. Ninety two take away twenty nine is sixty three, and that divided by nine is seven.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Seven is not three, so the result changes with the number.
